eg_companies = self.env.companies.filtered(lambda c: c.country_id.code == 'EG') payslips = self.env['hr.payslip'].search([ ('id', 'in', active_ids), ('company_id', 'in', eg_companies.ids), ]) payslips = payslips.filtered(lambda p: p._origin) warning_records = self.env['hr.payslip'] warning_details = defaultdict(list) for payslip in payslips: employee_fields = payslip.employee_id._fields if not payslip.employee_id.identification_id: warning_records |= payslip warning_details[payslip].append({ 'message': _get_payroll_translation("Missing field '%(field_label)s' to print ETA-form2.", field_label=employee_fields['identification_id'].string), 'action_text': _get_payroll_translation('Employee'), 'action': payslip.employee_id._get_records_action(), 'level': 'danger', })
